structured_output.analysis: The budget is 403/128 bits per weight. iso_3.15 [E514ab09c524e] sits almost exactly on it, so any upgrade has to be paid for. The evidence has no cheap downgrade to fund one: the tabled moves have no funding sources. My plan is to free bits by setting weight.group_size=256 for rht_gptq_int3, the largest method pool, which cuts the per-group scale overhead. That pays for raising the top-loss MLP layers by one bit. Last round's proposals were refused only because the rationales quoted a rounded whole-recipe KL. These rationales quote only single-layer KL values exactly as they appear in the cited records. The act_order proposal is resubmitted on its own because it costs no bits.

proposals.name: g256_rht3_top3_upgrades
proposals.rationale: Setting weight.group_size=256 on rht_gptq_int3 frees scale bits, which pay for three one-bit MLP upgrades. Single-layer KL: model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj rht_gptq_int2 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065] vs rht_gptq_int3 0.00181478 [E90bd4b2f3645]; model.layers.27.mlp.gate_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67] vs rht_gptq_int4 0.00153131 [Ef428ac081334]; model.layers.3.mlp.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5] vs gptq_int4 0.00237732 [Ef4ee8cb4969e].

proposals.name: g256_rht3_top6_upgrades
proposals.rationale: A more aggressive version of the weight.group_size=256 trade on rht_gptq_int3, upgrading more of the top-loss MLP layers. model.layers.2.mlp.up_proj gptq_int3 0.00641875 [E9baa10763ebe] vs gptq_int4 0.00237045 [Ef3d9c7b4502c]; model.layers.1.mlp.up_proj rht_gptq_int3 0.00611131 [E0564bc6ad1eb] vs rht_gptq_int4 0.00227173 [E779bc065b72e]; model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj gptq_int3 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded] vs gptq_int4 0.00216589 [Efea8c18d2abc]; plus the upgrades for block14 down, block27 gate and block3 up [E4c3f9b73e065][Efa0bb391da67][E6f4f7ea296d5].

proposals.name: opt_act_order_r2
proposals.rationale: Costs no bits: weight_algo.act_order=true on every GPTQ-family method. The top-loss layers are GPTQ-quantized MLP layers with heavy-tailed inputs: model.layers.27.mlp.up_proj activation kurtosis 1090.09 [E24beed188b6a] and gptq_int3 KL 0.0057182 [Ef04d8aa7bded]. Processing columns in activation order should lower the GPTQ error there.

proposals.name: actorder_g256_rht3_top3
proposals.rationale: Combines weight_algo.act_order=true with the weight.group_size=256 trade on rht_gptq_int3, so act_order can offset the coarser groups. Upgrade gains: model.layers.14.mlp.down_proj 0.00633466 [E4c3f9b73e065] to 0.00181478 [E90bd4b2f3645]; model.layers.27.mlp.gate_proj 0.00498703 [Efa0bb391da67] to 0.00153131 [Ef428ac081334]; model.layers.3.mlp.up_proj 0.0064177 [E6f4f7ea296d5] to 0.00237732 [Ef4ee8cb4969e].
